post.description:
Use for regulation detail. 'registration' finds the edition from the year page, then the issue index (three requests); 'url' reads a page from get_issue, list_issues or list_consultations directly (French -fra URLs are read in English). Part I notice pages hold every notice of one section of the issue.

200.description:
Read one Canada Gazette document: a Part II regulation or statutory instrument by registration number (SOR/2026-206, SI/2026-58) or any Part I or Part II page by URL. Returns title, issue, registration date, enabling act, Privy Council number, the Part I prepublication statement and date from the impact analysis (proposal-to-final link), for Part I proposed regulations the statutory authorities, sponsoring department and comment period (ORCS id, closing date), and the plain text.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consultation` | object | Part I proposed regulations open to online comment. |
| `enabling_act` | string | Part II: enabling statute line as printed (upper case), e.g. 'EXPLOSIVES ACT'. |
| `issue` | object |  |
| `kind` | string | regulation = SOR, statutory_instrument = SI (Part II); proposed_regulation = a Part I regN page; notice = any other Part I page. |
| `license` | object |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `part` | string |  |
| `prepublication` | object | Part II: the impact analysis sentence on prepublication in Part I; null when the page has none. |
| `privy_council_number` | string | Order in Council number, e.g. 'P.C. 2026-960', when the instrument was made by the Governor in Council. |
| `registration` | string | Part II: SOR/YYYY-N or SI/YYYY-N. |
| `registration_date` | string | Part II: YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `sponsoring_department` | string |  |
| `statutory_authorities` | string[] | Part I proposed regulations: enabling statutes. |
| `text` | string | Plain text, one line per block, cut at max_text_chars. |
| `text_chars` | number |  |
| `text_truncated` | boolean |  |
| `title` | string |  |
